en-US.name: Blender Skills
en-US.summary: Catalog collection of 94 specialist Blender skills (.claude/skills copy, not the duplicate .cursor tree) for pipelines from blockout to engine export. Needs local Blender and a separately configured Blender MCP server. Admission is paused at listing-only: the current DesireCore collection installer copies only each selected child path and does not attach the repository-root MIT LICENSE.
en-US.description: Pinned at 904f095d8f36a6e72adaebb08d07f884a074743d. Upstream root LICENSE is MIT, but it lives outside every child path under .claude/skills; a child install therefore does not receive the license text. There is no existing per-child license field in the market entry schema, and the client does not copy parent evidence into staged children. Collection structure and child selection are kept; installable admission is paused until a client change can attach root LICENSE (or an equivalent supported evidence path) to each selected child. This is not a runtime acceptance of Blender or MCP.

zh-CN.name: Blender Skills
zh-CN.summary: 94 个面向生产管线的 Blender 专项技能合集（收录 .claude/skills 副本，不含重复的 .cursor 树），覆盖从体块到引擎导出。需本机 Blender 与另行配置的 Blender MCP。准入暂停为仅收录：现行 DesireCore 合集安装器只复制所选子路径，不会把仓库根目录的 MIT LICENSE 附进子项安装产物。
zh-CN.description: 固定版本 904f095d8f36a6e72adaebb08d07f884a074743d。上游根 LICENSE 为 MIT，但位于每个 .claude/skills 子路径之外，因此按子项安装时不会得到许可文本。现行目录条目 schema 没有每子额外许可字段，客户端也不会把父级证据复制进子项产物。合集结构与子项点选予以保留；在客户端能把根 LICENSE（或等效的受支持证据路径）附到所选子项之前，可安装准入暂停。此收录不代表对 Blender 或 MCP 的运行验收。

requirements.value: Requires a local Blender installation supported by the upstream MCP workflow. The skills do not bundle Blender.
Requires a separately configured Blender MCP server matching the repo's .mcp.json; MCP and Blender follow their own terms.
Blender and MCP actions can modify scene files and run local tools. Confirm the target project and permissions before execution; stop if Blender or MCP is unavailable.

Not admitted for install: installing a selected child copies only that child path and does not include the repository-root MIT LICENSE. Admission stays listing-only until the client can attach that evidence to each selected child.
